name: team_planning_pin_change
description: Pin what a scenario of a Team Planning plan inherits for one facet of one subject, as it resolves now, so a later change in its parent no longer reaches it: the 'keep the plan' answer when reconciling. facet is as team_planning_overrides lists it, such as 'rule:<name>'. The pin records where the value came from. Refused for the baseline, for a facet the scenario already changes, or unless the caller is an editor.
